meta.what: The meaning of record for each wiki dictionary entry, under the ruling recorded as proposal 6 in docs/decisions-log.md.
meta.credit: Official definitions are quoted as compiled and cited by Thuum.org in its Fifth Edition (non-commercial use; see research/sources/thuum/ATTRIBUTION.md). Wiki wordings are from UESP (CC BY-SA 2.5).

fields.checked: whether the cited source has been or can be checked
fields.printed_in_copy: what the Fifth Edition copy prints where that is a known misprint
